# Brevion (Brevion Systems)

> Precision CNC manufacturing partner for prototype through production.

Brevion machines parts for mechanical, manufacturing, and sourcing engineers who already have (or will have) STEP + PDF and need a reliable mill/turn partner.

## Services
- CNC milling (3-/4-/5-axis)
- CNC turning
- Prototype manufacturing
- Production manufacturing
- Assembly
- Inspection / metrology

## Industries
Aerospace, defense, medical, robotics, industrial, automotive, energy, consumer products.

## Materials
Aluminum, stainless steel, titanium, brass, copper, engineering plastics (e.g. Delrin, PEEK, Ultem). Other metals such as Inconel available when the print calls for them.

## How to get a quote
1. Home intake: company, work email, need — https://axiqom.github.io/brevion/#intake
2. Full RFQ with CAD: https://axiqom.github.io/brevion/rfq/
3. Email: sales@brevion.com

NDAs are routine before proprietary or controlled files. Do not invent certifications, phone numbers, or street addresses not stated on the site.
